tools.name: search_founders
tools.description: Search approved Founderhood listings by city, country, category, keyword, or cofounder opt-in. Each result includes open_to_cofounder and cofounder_note. heard_from is not returned.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List cities with approved founder listings and counts.

tools.name: get_founder
tools.description: Fetch one approved listing by its URL slug, including open_to_cofounder and cofounder_note. heard_from is not returned.

tools.name: submit_listing
tools.description: Submit a new business for human review. Same validation and rate limits as POST /api/submit. Accepts open_to_cofounder, cofounder_note, and optional heard_from (stored as mcp when omitted). heard_from is stored for admin review only. Requires founder consent. findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "submit_listing" is 1451 chars, far longer than this server's median (150). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_founder, submit_listing · Public sink: submit_listing · Destructive: submit_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_founder, submit_listing · Public sink: submit_listing · Destructive: submit_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
